findings.closure_requirement: Independent review of the frozen fix and regression results; append closure without erasing this finding.
findings.description: The default parameter reads globalThis.sessionStorage outside the guarded body. A denied getter throws SecurityError before listener registration and before createRoot, leaving the app unmounted. This is an existing release-readiness defect observed during the bounded review, not a claim that the V1 UI diff introduced it.
findings.reproduction: Independently imported installReleaseRecovery, installed a configurable sessionStorage getter that throws DOMException SecurityError, and invoked with stub target/location/schedule while omitting storage. Observed SecurityError; listener registered=false. Existing normal-storage tests did not cover this boundary.
findings.required_remediation: Obtain browser storage inside a guarded lookup, preserve bootstrap with unavailable storage, and test the denied-getter path plus repeated preload-error handling. Regenerate the SPA after the source fix.

limits: This finite review did not investigate every historical source file or claim browser coverage; the separate browser matrix remains required.
No installed fixtures, application source, or frontend assets were edited by this review.
Catalog and reserve judgments retain their explicit bundled-release selection boundary; raw inventory and selectable stock differ.
Compiled assets must be rebuilt after any final recovery source edit.
scope: Bounded source review of changed start/replay/help flows, daily navigation intent and saved-round precedence, native details/focus accessibility, responsive tile changes, and catalog/package source coupling. Independent runtime probes and prior content reviews are cited separately; this is not a full application security or accessibility certification.
